notes:
Summary: Blackbeam Systems is a regional power grid control operator evaluating Redwood Private for an air-gapped, on-prem inference stack to support control-room assistants, automated alert triage, and document search across SOPs and incident reports. Heavy emphasis on FIPS/HSM integration, no external egress, and a sealed update process for model binaries.

Engagement status: evaluation. AE (Priya) introduced via gov channel 2026-01-20. Initial intro call 2026-01-29 (FF-20260129-3310). Security kickoff 2026-02-11 (see FF-20260211-9241). POC scoped: 6-week on-prem POC in isolated lab (air-gapped VLAN) w/ sim traffic from SCADA testbed.

Technical constraints / requirements (customer-provided):
- Must run in an isolated network segment with no outbound internet. USB/physical medium allowed for model updates only after sealed attestation.
- HSM-backed key storage (FIPS 140-2 level); prefer existing Thales Luna integration.
- Audit logging retained 7 years; immutable logs exported to internal SIEM (Splunk).
- Operator SSO via SAML + RBAC, integration with Okta/Onelogin.
- Ability to banlist certain tokens/phrases and enforce deterministic rollbacks on regressions.
- Model residency: models and weights cannot leave site; Redwood control-plane components must be deployable in-customer VPC or offline.
- Certification targets: FedRAMP High (long-term), immediate need: internal compliance sign-off and FIPS crypto validation.

POC scope and acceptance criteria:
- Deploy Redwood Private (air-gapped) in Blackbeam lab, integrate with HSM, run chat assistant for control-room queries with <250ms median response for 64-token replies in lab (best-effort), and indexing/search for 10k doc corpus with <200ms median embedding query.
- Verify offline model update workflow (signed bundles), SIEM ingestion of audit logs, and SSO/RBAC enforcement.
- Performance/cost report and security attestation delivered at POC close.

- 2026-01-29: Intro call (stakeholders: CTO Sarah Mendoza, Head of OT Eng. D. Alvarez).
